steps.content: What a shame. They were so young... And their poor daughter.
What on earth happened?
I don't know. They wouldn't tell us anything. They wouldn't even allow their names to be written on it.
They just sent over a pair of medals.
Well, it's an honor in a way, dying for DisCity. They died with dignity.
The mourning passersby are driven away by a girl.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Get lost! All of you, get lost! We don't need your mourning!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Heh... No one will even remember your names after you sacrificed for them!
The girl angrily kicks at the poppy in front of the tomb.
That's the seed behind the FAC medal, buried with the merits in the sunless soil.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You really think that other people's lives are more valuable than your own?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Who decided that? Why?
The girl sneers, cutting her wrist with her fingernail, and a strange black mist pours out.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hey, you want to consume me, don't you?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Go on. But in exchange, I have a request.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I don't want to become a meaningless pawn in someone else's hand. No one can measure the value of my life.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: As long as I'm strong enough... I can live for myself.

steps.speaker: Official
steps.content: Why...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Why not? Isn't it natural for an assassin to do what they're paid for?

steps.speaker: Official
steps.content: Ha! Yeah... you're just a bunch of money-grubbing lunatics!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Oh? So should I say, you're dying under the hands of a crazy Sinner for the future of DisCity—Does that make your death more valuable, "honored guests"?
The assassin doesn't give them a chance to respond. The alley is filled with the stench of decay.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hmph... You saw my gorgeous moves, why don't you even smile?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I gave you an "honorable" death. It was your favorite thing, no? Why weren't you happy about it?
Coquelic forces a smile onto the stiff, lifeless face with her fingers, then irritably moves her hands away.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: You brought despair, pain, and sadness to others. I was just letting you experience them all over again.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: This is how fairness works in DisCity, hahaha... cough, cough!
The emotion triggers pain, but she seems to have gotten used to the torment brought by her power. She nonchalantly wipes her mouth and plants a seed in the pool of blood.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The grand awards you gave out back then, I now return them to you.
The slender figure disappears at the end of the dark alley.
She's lost count of how many poppies she's given out. Maybe ten, a hundred, or a thousand.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Whether it's the Garden's commissions or the nemesis of fate... I can clear them all.
Finally, she got her revenge.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: It's done?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Yes.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Are you sure it's him?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Yes, he was the person in charge of the operation that my parents participated in.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Good. You've worked hard over the years, take a good rest.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: What, you have something to say about it?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Quite a few people were gone while I was away.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Yes, there was a dangerous mission from the Underground. To salvage the situation, we had to put out some bait.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: We achieved our goal, so they didn't die in vain.
The grown-up assassin doesn't answer. She calmly blows the dust off her fingertips.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: It's their glory as assassins to die for the Underground.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: Coquelic, don't forget. The Garden supported you, trained you, and helped you gather information for your revenge.

steps.speaker: Mentor
steps.content: One day, you will also...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Die for your plans?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I thought the Garden would be a good place because you accepted Sinners... but it's just the same.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: What does your ambition have to do with the rest of the Garden?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Since you're so interested in that sunless place, I'll take you there myself.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I won't let myself become such a self-indulgent joke...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...nor my flowers.

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I don't want to lose my family again...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: The Garden is your home. You'll have a family.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: He needs to be punished!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Go all the way then. I'll teach you how.

steps.speaker: Gekkabijin
steps.content: I need to be stronger. I don't want to be stepped on by anyone!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Then beat me, or kill me.

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Please forgive me, I might have to follow him again.
steps.female_content: Please forgive me, I might have to follow her again.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ha, you bet everything on that person. What if you get betrayed?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: ...I don't care.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Don't regret it.
Make your dreams come true! Seek your revenge! My flowers, my Garden, should be free, willful, and grow wildly.
If there are any weeds, just get rid of them.

steps.speaker: Mania
steps.content: Roar...
Is it time? Are you taking me?
Just a little longer...
Coquelic is waiting for something, but she can't tell what is it.
She just quietly lies in the corner of her consciousness in the sea of flowers, looking back at her life.
Hatred, violence, chaos, and indulgence—perhaps that's all she was.
Even at the end of her life, she ends it with an absurd interrogation that ends in mutual destruction.
I never answered his question in the end...
steps.female_content: I never answered her question in the end...

steps.content:
"You accepted the commission, exposed the Underground, surrendered to us, and are now testing the limits of the shackles..."
"Are you really doing all these on a whim?"
I transferred so much Mania into that Chief. There won't be much time left.
He won't have the chance to hear the answer, and I... don't need to tell him.
steps.female_content: She never had the chance to hear the answer, and I... I don't need to tell her.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Paradeisos and the Underground think the Garden is obliterated, and I've settled the final threat—the shackles. My Garden...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: There's nothing to worry about.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Nothing at all...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: I'd rather die than let anyone hurt them... You can dream of getting past me...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: Arghhhh!
This is...

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: I'm sorry... Mentor... forgive me...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Here we go again! Stop crying!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: How many times have I told you! Don't act on your own! Don't care about others so much!

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I'm just a bad woman who locks you up in solitary every day. Stop pestering me, I'm not your mom.

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: No, I can't... I...

steps.speaker: Gekkabijin
steps.content: I haven't beaten you yet! I haven't become the strongest flower in the Garden!
Why are these memories surfacing right now?

steps.speaker: Garden Assassin
steps.content: Mentor, we'll cover you. You retreat first.
Why, in my last moments...
Why am I seeing these?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: How ridiculous... my final attachment? I always accomplish everything alone, how could I have such a thing...
Then why are you still here...

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: ...waiting for us to appear?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Do you really... have no attachments left?

steps.speaker: Sumire
steps.content: Mentor...

steps.speaker: Garofano
steps.content: ...Mentor?

steps.speaker: Electrocardiograph
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>"Beep... beep..."</size></color>
<color=#7683a2><size=30>How is she?</size></color>

steps.speaker: Medical Team
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>She pulled through! It worked!</size></color>

steps.speaker: Medical Team
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>But... if we continue, it'll be bad for you, Chief!</size></color>
<color=#7683a2><size=30>It's okay, I know what I'm doing. Keep going, transfer all her Mania to me.</size></color>

steps.speaker: Gekkabijin
steps.content: Hey!

steps.speaker: Thistle
steps.content: I was wrong!

steps.speaker: Garden Assassin
steps.content: Ms. Coquelic...

steps.speaker: Electrocardiograph
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>"Beep beep beep..."</size></color>

steps.speaker: Medical Team
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>Monitor her heart rate and blood pressure!</size></color>

steps.speaker: Medical Team
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>They're all returning to normal!</size></color>

steps.speaker: Medical Team
steps.content: <color=#7683a2><size=30>Chief, the Mania you've absorbed has already exceeded how much the shackles can take!</size></color>
<color=#7683a2><size=30>Keep going!</size></color>
<color=#7683a2><size=35>She still wants to live.</size></color>
<color=#7683a2>...And there are people waiting for her.</color>
A poppy can bloom beautifully on its own... Why are there always fools doing useless things for me...
But this time, do I have a chance... to tell him the answer to that question?
steps.female_content: But this time, do I have a chance... to tell her the answer to that question?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content:
"You accepted the commission, exposed the Underground, surrendered to us, and are now testing the limits of the shackles..."
"Are you really doing all these on a whim?"

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: No, it's for...

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...my Garden.
